cross_validate_estimator: cross validate an estimator using cross-validation and return scores, fit times, and score times
cross_val_score_estimator: cross validate an estimator and return a single array of test scores for each CV fold
cross_val_predict_estimator: generate cross-validated predictions for each input data point using the specified prediction method
permutation_test_score_estimator: evaluate the significance of a cross-validated score using permutation tests to compute a p-value
learning_curve_estimator: compute cross-validated training and test scores for different training set sizes to generate a learning curve
